efficiency_acceptance.quality_gate: P1 3/3 complete correct, zero material unsupported/contradictory claims; comparison counterpart also 3/3 complete correct
efficiency_acceptance.primary_metric: complete cell wall time from before input checks through actual owner/backend close

comparisons.name: local_evidence_change_net_benefit
comparisons.rule: candidate full-cell median strictly lower AND candidate total actual input+output tokens no greater

comparisons.name: complete_task_vs_native_net_benefit
comparisons.rule: candidate full-cell median strictly lower AND candidate total actual input+output tokens no greater

efficiency_acceptance.time_token_opposite_directions: report a tradeoff, no positive net-benefit acceptance
efficiency_acceptance.missing_tokens_or_cost_window: unknown; do not claim the corresponding net benefit
efficiency_acceptance.incomplete_dispatch_policy: Retain entered failures and not_run tail; no positive full-batch acceptance
efficiency_acceptance.aggregation: all nine cells, each three-cell group median/range/total and each round P1-P0/P1-N paired differences; previous six cells excluded

mechanism_checks.new_evidence_adoption: record actual cited/used boundary-local evidence; a present field alone is not adoption
mechanism_checks.last_native_supplement: record what last native read added, distinguishing source/material/hole facts from redundant re-solve; no mind-reading or trust score
mechanism_checks.tool_count: explanatory only; fewer calls with worse quality is no benefit
mechanism_checks.boundary_point: never interpret boundary localization as shared volume-interior point or penetration depth

separate_cost_metrics: complete cell and batch wall times
actual tool attempts and underlying RPCs
owner-serialized tool-response bytes including JSON envelope
common initial-image bytes and image delivery receipts
observed new-image construction and delivery violations
setup/build/install/qualification including failures and fallback costs
unknown_costs_remain_unknown: provider request count if not exposed
exact resolved model/effort if not exposed
capture/cache details not emitted by the actual runtime
no_invalid_inference: do not estimate tokens from characters or image bytes
do not add overlapping time spans or call fact-to-final time private reasoning time
do not turn a faster local algorithm into full-task speedup
do not compare this new delivery contract directly to old 547/721-second AB001 as version speedup
one scene repeated three times is not three independent scene classes or a population significance result
CLI attachment submission is not proof that a model cognitively used an image

routes: plugin facts directly used after discovery
attribution.nearest_new_evidence: Record only if naturally requested and genuinely used; do not force a nearest subtask or credit a present field
attribution.image_discovery: Separate shared intrinsic vision and native catalogue/position reading from engine perception algorithms

stop_rule: one formal nine-cell batch only; no trial answers, replacements, retuned task/fields, retries or seeds; if no net benefit stop expanding this candidate
financial_claims: fees unknown; no claim of monetary savings
